'''Tenzan Shrine''' (天山社 or 天山神社) refers to a group of [[Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]] located in [[Saga Prefecture]] on [[Tianshan (disambiguation)|Tenzan (Saga Prefecture)]]. These shrines are traditionally regarded as the third shrine (三宮) of [[Hizen Province]]. There are four registered religious corporations under this name.

* [[Tenzan Shrine (Ogimachi Hatada)]] - Upper Shrine (上宮) located at the summit of Tenzan. Situated in Hatada, Ogimachi, Saga Prefecture.
* [[Tenzan Shrine (Main Shrine)]] - Known as the Lower Shrine (下宮) or Main Shrine (本宮). Located in Haruki, Ogimachi, Saga Prefecture.
* [[Tenzan Shrine (Ogimachi Iwakura)]] - Lower Shrine (下宮). Situated in Iwakura, Ogimachi, Saga Prefecture.
* [[Tenzan Shrine (Karatsu City)]] - Lower Shrine (下宮). Located in Hirose, Kyūragi Town, Karatsu City, Saga Prefecture.
